# psq4ios - PostgreSQL Monitor

Monitor your PostgreSQL databases in real-time, directly from your iPhone or iPad.

## Overview

psq4ios brings professional PostgreSQL monitoring to iOS. Connect securely to your databases and get instant visibility into server performance, active queries, connection states, and transaction throughput.

## Key Features

### Real-Time Monitoring
- Live dashboard refreshing every 2 seconds
- Active query tracking with execution time
- Connection state breakdown (active, idle, idle in transaction)
- Transaction throughput (TPS) with 5-minute sparkline visualization
- Replication stream health monitoring

### Query Management
- View full query text with syntax highlighting
- Cancel or terminate long-running queries
- Copy queries to clipboard for analysis
- Color-coded query states and execution times
- Sort by duration to identify bottlenecks

### Server Management
- Manage multiple PostgreSQL servers
- Custom colors and icons for easy identification
- Secure password storage in iOS Keychain
- Drag to reorder servers
- Last connected timestamp tracking

### Import & Export
- Import servers from pg_service.conf files
- Bulk import multiple database connections
- Quick setup from existing configurations

### Security
- Direct TLS-encrypted connections to PostgreSQL
- No third-party services or data collection
- Passwords stored securely in iOS Keychain
- All monitoring happens on-device

### Native iOS Experience
- Built with SwiftUI for smooth, native performance
- Dark mode support
- SF Symbols throughout
- Optimized for iPhone and iPad

## Perfect For

- **Database Administrators**: Monitor production databases from anywhere
- **DevOps Engineers**: Quick troubleshooting on the go
- **Backend Developers**: Check query performance during development
- **Site Reliability Engineers**: Respond to incidents from mobile

## Technical Details

- Connects directly to PostgreSQL 9.4+
- Uses PostgresNIO for robust connectivity
- TLS 1.2+ encryption required
- Supports standard PostgreSQL authentication
- Queries pg_stat_activity, pg_stat_database, and pg_stat_replication

## Requirements

- iOS 26.0 or later
- Network access to your PostgreSQL servers
- PostgreSQL server with TLS enabled
- Valid database credentials with appropriate permissions

## Privacy

PSQ respects your privacy:
- No analytics or tracking
- No data sent to third parties
- All connections are direct from your device to your servers
- Passwords stored only in iOS Key
